A dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Sith Saber''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[41 ABY]], [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] was summoned to the ruling [[Circle of Lords]]. When the Tyro arrived, the [[Sith Saber]], Saber [[Shura (Sith)|Shura]], and [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Kesh)|another Saber]] greeted Khai, and Shura took Khai to the [[Circle Chambers|chamber]] of the Circle of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]].

==Biography==
A dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was born on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], she was [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on Kesh thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] previously.<ref name="Omen" /> By [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> she had attained the rank of [[Sith Saber]]. In that year, the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] arrived on the world and contacted the [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]].<ref name="Omen" />

Khai was then summoned before the Tribe's ruling council, the [[Circle of Lords]], in the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] in the Kesh [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. There, the female [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Saber awaited Khai alongside two fellow Sabers, [[Shura (Sith)|Shura]] and a [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Kesh)|male Saber]]. When Khai arrived, the female Saber greeted the Tyro, and then Shura took Khai to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] in the [[Circle Chambers]].<ref name="Omen" />

==Personality and traits==
The dark-skinned female possessed the [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] required to achieve the rank of Sith Saber. Khai, a talented Sith Tyro, was unable to detect her presence until she heard the sound of the Saber's [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. The Saber was the first to speak to Khai while her two companions remained silent.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dark-skinned Sith Saber appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', written by [[Christie Golden]]. The Saber serves as a minor character in the book.<ref name="Omen" />
